sources.title: DINOv2 ONNX Inference - GitHub
sources.snippet: This repository contains a Python script (onnx_inference.py) for extracting and comparing image features using the DINOv2 model in ONNX format. The script uses the onnxruntime library to load and run the model.

sources.title: DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features without Supervision
sources.snippet: The recent breakthroughs in natural language processing for model pretraining on large quantities of data have opened the way for similar foundation models in computer vision. These models could greatly simplify the use of images in any system by producing all-purpose visual features, i.e., features that work across image distributions and tasks without finetuning.
